GRAIN POLICIES EFFECTIVE SEPTEMBER 1ST, 2026

SPOT CONTRACT
    No forward contract has been agreed upon with Siouxland Ethanol.                               CORN DISCOUNTS
    Corn priced at current market price at time of delivery.
    All corn delivered without an existing Cash, Basis, or DP contract(s) will be                       (LOAD BY LOAD BASIS)
       spotted at time of delivery unless prior arrangements have been made.
CASH CONTRACT                                                                                     Moisture
    Cash price has been established prior to delivery.
                                                                                              - 2% Shrink Per Point above 15.0% moisture
    Delivery period has been established prior to delivery.
                                                                                              - Shrink figured for each 0.5% Moisture
BASIS CONTRACTS (BASIS ONLY OR NO FUTURES PRICE ESTABLISHED)
    Basis contracts must be priced during CME trading hours 7:00pm - 7:45am                  - (Ex: 15.01-15.5 moisture=1% shrink)
       Sunday through Thursday and 8:30am - 1:20pm Monday through Friday.
    Must be priced (futures price set) or rolled (basis price adjusted for contract              Damage
       option month spread) the day prior to first notice day for the said Option             - 1 cent for each 0.5% over 5.0% up to 10.0%
       Month. (December 2026 futures must be priced or rolled before 11/30/26)
    Basis contracts must be priced in the crop year in which the original contract
                                                                                              - Over 10.0% subject to Rejection
       was written. (ex: A contract originally written for Oct ‘26 delivery with a basis
       versus Dec '26 futures and subsequently rolled to Sep '27 futures must be                  Heat Damage
       priced by 8/30/2027)                                                                   - 1 cent for each 0.1% over 0.2%
    Siouxland Ethanol has the right to price basis contracts at the market closing           - 2 cents for each 0.1% over 1.0%
       price the day prior to First Notice Day of the option month or the day prior to
       the end of the crop year (whatever comes first) if the producer has not made
                                                                                              - Over 3% subject to rejection
       prior arrangements with Siouxland Ethanol.
    Bushels must be delivered to roll unpriced contracts                                         Broken Corn and Foreign Material
HEDGE TO ARRIVE (HTA OR FUTURES ONLY)                                                         - 1 cent for each 0.5% over 3% to 7%
    Must contract 5,000 bu contract increments.                                              - 2 cents for each 0.5% 7.01% to 10%
    5 cent/bushel fee subtracted from futures price at time of contract.
                                                                                              - Over 10% Subject to Rejection
    Basis must be set prior to shipment.
    HTA contracts may be rolled, with a 1 cent/bushel fee subtracted from the
       spread between contract months                                                             Test Weight
    Contracts cannot be rolled between crop years. (ex: December 2026 futures                - 1 cent for each 0.5 lb under 54 down to
       subsequently rolled to September 2027 futures must have basis set prior to              50lbs
       First Notice Day of Sep 27 Futures; August 30th, 2027; and bushels                     - 2 cents for each 0.5 lb under 49.99 lbs
       delivered prior to September 30, 2027.)
                                                                                              - Under 45 lbs Subject to Rejection
    Siouxland Ethanol has the right to set basis at Spot Basis price for Spot
       Shipment Month if the producer has not instructed Siouxland Ethanol to set
       basis or roll prior to close of business the day before First Notice Day of the            Musty and/or Sour
       Option Month related to the HTA contract. (ex: basis will be set at spot price         - 10 cents per bushel or Subject to Rejection
       for December 2026 shipment if producer has not set basis or rolled the
       December 2026 HTA prior to close of business 11/27/26)
DEFERED PRICE (DP OR PRICE LATER)                                                                 Insect Bored or Damaged
    Title of grain passes to Siouxland Ethanol at time of delivery. Market Price             - 10 cents per bushel
       gain or loss is for the account of the seller.                                         - Live bugs present Subject to Rejection
    DP Contracts must be priced during CME trading hours 7:00pm - 7:45am
       Sunday through Thursday and 8:30am - 1:20pm Monday through Friday.
    An Unload Charge and subsequent Monthly Service Charge may be charged                        Other
       by Siouxland Ethanol at its discretion. All Charges will be disclosed and
       agreed upon at time of contract.                                                       - Rodent or Bird Contamination, Stones,
    The final pricing date will be disclosed and agreed upon at time of contract.             Glass, or other Commercially Undesirable
                                                                                               Foreign Material Subject to Rejection
